content: Nzam kàpiy anki Isàlɛl
Abun, mɛ in'fuul naa: Nkye Nzam kàpiy un'sɛŋ ande? Akà ikikye! Ntɔn mɛ ŋàkwo iwà un'nsi Isàlɛl, itoo a Abàlam, uboo a ywar a Bɛnsàmɛn.
Nzam kàpiy anki baar ande kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l nde itaan. Imɛnà naa bɛ làkayöbà anki naa Ndaa Aŋàsɔn nkye itɛɛnà, u mbwo aya kàsi Elya tär ntɔn Isàlɛl a Nzam:
« Mwol, ba bàkyer adwa aŋangɔɔm angye, bàpay mɛsà a ibɔɔn angye, mɛ kàsàsal mɛ mpɛl, anà ba bàkwen mukan'dwa sye! »
Wɛɛ, Nzam kàmun'fuur aben? « Mɛ kàyee ntɔn mɛ baar nsaab nsàmbwar yà abaal, baar mpa bàsàbwà kà an'bwaŋ kusà a Baal. »
Yà balàbal utaaŋ alà, ban'saal baar ikikye kan'sɔɔl Nzam unsà kab a ngway ande.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa unsà kab a ngway, kà unsà isal anki, iswaŋà naa kab a ngway kà là kab a ngway anki.
Apanà, bi ifàtɛn aben? Undiir ulɛŋà Isàlɛl, nde wa ŋàtàkaar anki, wɛɛ baar bàsɔ̈ɔ̈l bàkyer akaar wa, wɛɛ akà bumwɛy, mpem aba yàbulà bwoor,
asànaa bàsön ya naa: « Nzam kàpɛ dweelà a bɔɔmà, mii ntɔn ukɔɔn aman, an'tsü ntɔn ukɔɔn awem, tii ŋàbà. »
David waa kàtɛn sye naa:

content.text: « Wɛy mɛsà aba ibulà untaam anà an'tɛy ntɔn ba,
ntɔn mbwaeel anà ntaaŋàmbar ntɔn ba!
Wɛy mii aba ibü mpib, tii mpal bàyàfàman ba.

content: Waa mɛ in'fuulà naa: nkye ntɔn mbweel ipepey, waa ba bàsɛlà? Kà ndandaa anki! Wɛɛ ntɔn ibii aba, waa Nzam kàpɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ akà baar mpa abà Ayudà, ntɔn musɛn un'köl a Isàlɛl.
Kyekà, isàkal naa ibii aba byàpɛ un'naaŋ u mɛɛn, anà ntyeey aba un'naaŋ a baar mpa abà Ayudà, abun nsuub aba yàŋàkwo iyàtwaal un'naaŋ a nkye ifà?
Mɛ amàlakyään, ntɔn bɛ baar mpa làbà Ayudà: in'wà mɛ paa, mɛ, ntööm a baar mpa abà Ayudà, mɛ in'fàpà làkoo kà isal amɛ
unsà làkyän musɛn un'köl. Mɛ in'sii naa mɛ in'yàsɛɛn un'köl a atɔŋ amɛ unsà ndür ntɔn mutswà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a ndam a baar uboo a ba.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa nsyeel a ba ukɔl yàfuur un'tüüb a Nzam anà mɛɛn, mfurà aba iyàkal aben? Ya isàkal asànaa mfurà a baar fà ukwà tii u mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Kyekà, isàkal naa kab atàtwɛb là in'kyɛɛl, mfwar yanswà iyàkal in'kyɛɛl, isàkal naa un'swɛy wà in'kyɛɛl, an'kɔkà màyàkal mà in'kyɛɛl.

Wɛɛ isàkal naa an'kɔkà mamwɛy bàkyàtsuul, wɛɛ ngye, un'te a ɔlive a ndwaŋ, ngye bakön uboo a an'kɔkà màsàsal kà un'te a ɔlivɛ ntɔn badii anà ma u mbwo a un'swɛy mwɛy anà u mbwo a inɔ̈ mwɛy kya,
twon an'swaŋ ngaal kusà a an'kɔkà amàŋàtsul. Ngye an'kwo aswɛŋ ngaal, wɛɛ kà ngye anki asɛɛnà un'swɛy, wɛɛ un'swɛy akasɛɛnà.
Apan, ngye ayàtɛn naa: « An'kɔkà bàtsül ma ntɔn mɛ ban'kön. »
Ye abwɛy. Bàtsül ba ma ntɔn bwoor a mpem a ba. Wɛɛ ngye, unsà làkwikilà waa ngye awà paa. Twon an'sɛn an'pɛy, wɛɛ kal kà igyɛɛŋ.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa Nzam kàtii anki an'kɔkà màfàtoo ma ŋakwo, kal kà igyɛɛŋ, manà nde ukɔ̈ɔ̈n asatii, akà ikikye!
Ler ubwaŋ anà nsyeel a mii a Nzam: nsyeel a mii akà baar abà bàbü, ubwaŋ akà ngye, isàkal naa ngye awà mulalà uboo a ubwaŋ ba, naa tɛy, ngye sye bàkyer asalwom.
Wɛɛ akà ba, isàkal naa ba ban'wɛy bwoor a mpem aba, ba bàkyer asakɔn, ba sye, ntɔn Nzam we anà ikɔ̈b mukakɔn mbalà asin.

Abun, isàkal naa ngye, ngye kàlwomà unsà un'te a olivɛ a ndwaŋ awà katwey wa ŋakwo, waa bakön unsà un'te a ɔlive a boo a bul, itàkal naa kà wa anki katwey, ntɔn nkye mpa bàfuur kà un'te a ɔlive a boo a bul an'kɔkà amà kàtwey nde ŋakwo?
Mɔ̈ɔ̈ a ntsüü a baar a Isàlɛl

Ntɔn mɛ inkwen anki, atɔŋ, naa bɛ làkɔ̈ɔ̈n ayöb ngyee ayi, manà bɛ làyamɛnà naa bɛ làbà aŋan'yeerà: ndam a baar a Isàlɛl, mpem aba isàkal yàŋàbwà bwoor mbɔɔn tii mpal bàsàbilà baar mpa abà Ayudà banswà uboo a un'sɛŋ a Nzam.
Apan, Isàlɛl kyanswà isàwà mɔ̈ɔ̈, asànaa bàsön ya naa:

content.text: « Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ asàtoo u Siyɔnà,
Ya isàkal nkwà amɛ anà ba,

content: Ntɔn Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ, ba bà ayiiŋ a Nzam, ntɔn ubwaŋ abɛ, wɛɛ, ntɔn nsɔ̈ɔ̈l a Nzam, ba bànkween ntɔn bànkaa aba.
Ntɔn, Nzam ufàduum anki kab a ngway ufàpà nde, nde ufàsɔɔm anki mbeel ande.
Abun sye, itaan, bɛ Nzam lun'kyeyà anki, apanà, ntɔn unkwem aba, bɛ bàkyàlasyääm,
abun, ukɔɔn unkyeey aba apanà kan'kyer naa Nzam kisyääm, anà nde usyääm sye ba banswà.
Ntɔn, Nzam kàbäm baar banswà uboo a unkwem ntɔn musyääm ba banswà.
Ɔɔ, indübà a un'naaŋ, a an'yeerà anà a un'yɛnà a Nzam! Ntsüül a mbar ande ufàgyool anki, mbwo ande ufàkul anki!
Asànaa itɛɛnà Ndaa Aŋàsɔn:

content.text: Itàkal naa nà kan'kwo mukal un'pɛɛl a an'lwɛŋ ande?

content: Ntɔn undiir wanswà afü akà nde, u mbwo a nde, ntɔn nde. Akà nde làkoo a mbul a in'tye! Yà abwɛy.
